reviews.text:
Update:
It was an emergency. A scratched eye on a puppy is very serious! I never told them that I thought that she didn’t have a scratch on her eye. After monitoring her until the end of that day I then thought that she was ok but I still wanted to make sure. The gaslighting and manipulation needs to stop! They do not care about animals. I was literally crying on the phone to them and they did nothing!!!! Do not go here. I’ve submitted a report to the board about them. They are disgusting. They lied about the termination because they performed malpractice. I was not rude with the staff. The dr was not in surgery all day. They told me that she was seeing patients. Later that day they told me that she just got into surgery. Everything they told me in the termination letter was a lie. They are seriously insane! If you care about your animal do not go here! Stay far far away from this place!

The receptionists/ vet techs and doctors here do not care about sick animals and perform malpractice. My 4 month old puppy had an eye injury and the receptionists did nothing to help me. I had a feeling that she didn't have a scratch because she seemed fine but I just wanted to make sure. The doctor told me to send videos to the hospital of any injuries that may happen. I sent videos of Olive's eye to the receptionist and asked her if she could show the doctors to see if she had a scratch. The receptionist told me that she would. I waited 2 hours and heard nothing. I called again and they told me that they left a note in her box. I asked if they could please ask her as soon as possible since I was very scared that she might have a scratch on her eye. She said that she would. I waited an hour and heard nothing. I called again and told her that this was an emergency. She told me that the doctor is in surgery and she will look through her notes and prioritize what's important. I asked her to please tell her after she got out of surgery because I didn't trust any of the other doctors around me and wanted to see her. She told me that she would. I didn't hear back from her. That was on Friday. The doctor was gone all weekend. I called on Monday around 3:00 pm because I still didn't hear back from her. The receptionists gave me attitude and were extremely callous. She lied and told me that she left the note on the doctor's desk on Friday. When I talked to the receptionist on Friday she told me that she couldn't push the note. She told me that the doctor would choose what was most important. They wouldn't help my 4 month old puppy with what could have been a serious eye injury. I've spent so much money here and it is inconceivable to believe that someone could treat a 4 month old puppy or animal this way. They are so cruel and disgusting. The receptionist/manager Rose then had the audacity to tell me that they would then charge me for phone consultations because I sent too many pictures and videos. I sent 2 pictures and 1 video. The receptionists told me to send updates of Olive if there was any. The doctor recommended that I get eye drops without doing any tests. Her eyes ended up being ok. I made an appointment but ended up not going. After the receptionists repeatedly lied to me I did not feel comfortable going to this place again. After a couple of days I got an email from them telling me that they were going to terminate me. They lied about why they were terminating me. As I mentioned before I had an emergency. The doctor told me that I could contact her at anytime. I missed one appointment because I forgot to cancel. They were definitely trying to save themselves from a malpractice lawsuit. The gaslighting, callous behavior, and audacity that goes on in this place is inconceivable. They are disgusting and do not care about animals. They are sociopathic for lying and turning my puppy away to save their own butt to not get into trouble. I had a medical emergency and they did not care at all! They are seriously horrible! Do not go here!!!!
Compassionate testing and consultation for our dog.  A terrific, gifted, compassionate  vet, with expertise, who truly cares and has caring, upbeat staff who go beyond o be helpful!
So helpful and kind! They explained all the services listed on the invoice and were supportive in ensuring my reactive cat got the care she needed

What an amazing vet experience! We had previously come from a vet that was really impatient and harsh to us and our dog. A friend recommended this spot and we are so glad we took the rec. The vet tech and the vet were so kind and sweet to our pup and patient in chatting with us. We will be back and feel so relieved to have found our family vet.
Always have a great experience at LFSAH! They take great care of my dog 🐶 …
Thank you for the 5-star review! We appreciate your feedback.
awesome! maxine and andi are the best.

Updated review:
Unfortunately, my dog recently got cancer. This put me in the position to actually test LFSAH’s care team in a more complicated and serious context than our usual nail trim and vax appointments. I was pretty disappointed.

1. Dr. Talwar is a nice lady, but she did not instill a lot of confidence throughout this process. She told me “I have no idea what this is” in our first appointment (meanwhile my gut instinct was correct). Every time she called to explain test results, she sounded nervous and she oversimplified, so when I actually received the results via email, I had questions. Luckily, one of my best friends is a vet, and she explained all possible scenarios as well as all test results thoroughly.

2. Dr. Talwar “referred” me to a soft tissue surgeon after our biopsy suggested cancer. She said “choose any soft tissue surgeon on our referral list, it doesn’t matter, they're all good” and the front desk emailed me a list of local surgical hospitals. The “referral list” was no better than a google search result and included a hospital that didn't have a surgeon on staff. The admins at the specialist hospitals were confused that I was calling myself and they all asked why I wasn’t referred to an oncologist. I didn't know. I ultimately chose MASH because they have an oncologist and a surgeon on staff at the same facility. I wrote LFSAH an email with questions about the referral (why not oncology?) and explained my logic about choosing MASH. I waited over 24hrs, and then called because I hadn’t received a response. The front desk then told me that Theo’s notes said “Looks like Dr Talwar recommended MASH because they have an oncologist.” No, I said that in my email, which was ignored. MASH also didn’t receive Theo’s medical records / test results from LFSAH, so I had to send them myself. We moved forward with treatment from MASH and I haven’t heard from LFSAH since. Ultimately, we DID need an oncologist’s opinion, and Theo needed chemotherapy. Good thing I didn’t “pick any soft tissue surgeon.”

3. At one point when Theo was going in for a biopsy, which requires general anesthesia, I thought it would be wise to add an elective dental cleaning. I told the admins that I was planning to use insurance for the biopsy, and pay out of pocket for the dental since it was not covered. I didn’t want to risk my insurance denying coverage because unrelated procedures were combined on the invoice. The office manager at LFSAH called me back (first, she left a vm - transcription attached - then, I called her back) and she told me that separating the invoice would be “insurance fraud” and therefore “unethical”, so they couldn’t do it. Also, their invoicing system couldn’t separate by line item. She used the word “unethical” no less than 7 times on the phone. I was so taken aback by the defensive and accusatory rationale. I feel like repeatedly telling me that I was asking them to do something “unethical” was insensitive and unnecessary. Like, read the room.

4. This was the nail in the coffin: when Theo was a puppy, he had a heart murmur (ventricular septal defect). His previous vet told me to be careful about general anesthesia and to keep an eye on it in case it got worse. For the last 3.5+ years, I’ve been taking Theo to LFSAH for annual physicals, vaccines, etc. They listen to his heart almost every time. I also mention the murmur at every checkup. They haven’t heard a murmur once, so I figured it must have healed. I raised a red flag again recently because he’s had to go under GA multiple times, and Dr Talwar essentially gaslit me. Lo and behold, when I took him to MASH, the surgeon said “Theo has a grade 2 heart murmur” and “it’s pretty obvious.” He mentioned this because he was concerned about GA. Awesome. He then told me “tell your GP to listen higher on his chest cavity." I’m sorry, what?

5. Pricing for biopsy pathology: LFSAH charged $737; MASH charged $509.

TLDR I would not recommend LFSAH for anything other than routine stuff, and even then, cross your fingers they notice if something is wrong.

New to this clinic, just a wellness exam and a follow-up shot.  They were punctual and staff is friendly.  The doctor, Ryan, was pretty thorough with an easygoing manner.  Will retain their services in the future.
So far I like them

Do not go here if you want a fair and kind place for your pets when they are suffering. Your pet is just a number. The office management is poorly organized which creates a burdensome atmosphere if your pet is in medical distress. The name is cute. But the people who run this clinic have no value for pets life in a real way. Most traumatic experience I’ve ever had when dealing with a clinic of any kind after being a patient hear for years. Go to MEDIA CITY ANIMAL HOSPITAL. Nice staff, extremely professional, wonderful dr who are not highly turned over like LFSAH and overall seems like the office in general is happy and not dysfunctional like LFSAH.
I took my dog in to get a lump checked out. He got a very thorough physical and they answered all my questions.
Good service!
Professional caring staff.....Top notch Vets and front office/technicial staff...thank you for caring and loving our pet.

Dr.Erlinger was kind and supportive to our sweet Stevie Nicks (and me)  for her dental procedure.  4 extractions two days ago and she’s already running around like the mad woman she is.  Yes yes. It’s very expensive, but what isn’t.  It’s still less expensive than a feline dental specialist, and he seems to have all of the skills and finesse.  This is the 4th cleaning our cats have had and the only one with extractions. I trust them to be conservative and do only what is necessary. Dr. Talwar has also been excellent for the cleanings.   I appreciate this office and everyone who works there!

Dr Noda(covering for vet on maternity leave) performed Micki’s yearly physical.  Micki is a 12 year old cat suspicious of all vets!! Dr Noda was thorough and charming and put Micki (and us!) at ease.  (Ron and Jan Leath)
Dr Freedberg treated our cat Timmy for a suspected recurring allergy.  She was very thorough and caring with her exam and Timmy is feeling much better!

I have been bringing my cats here for a couple of years now, one of them has pretty major behavioral issues but Dr. Ehlinger is always so patient and understanding. He really takes the time to explain options and it feels like he genuinely cares about the well being of his patients. The vet techs and front desk staff are always so warm and quick to help.

I really feel like I found a gem and will be bringing my pets here for a long time to come!!

10/10

I have 2 cats, one of which has had some very bad vet experiences and is terrified. She can behave aggressively in response. After a stressful visit, she will be obviously distressed, sometimes for weeks. She has had to come to the vet a few times this week, and we brought her to LFSAH, where she was treated gently and kindly. After a full day of procedures where I couldn't be with her, she came home a little hungry, but otherwise in good spirits. They've been communicative and quick to call me with results.
The vet was also really sweet and comforting with me when I had a meltdown about how worried I was about my cat and her health.
Thank you for the 5-star review!
Thank you for the 5-star review!

Booking an appointment at Los Feliz Small Animal Hospital was very easy and convenient. The staff was friendly and welcoming, and I really enjoyed my experience with the vet. She was practical, knowledgeable, and straightforward, and she made several great suggestions for caring for my cat. I appreciated that her recommendations felt thoughtful and realistic rather than excessive. Overall, it was a very positive experience, and I would definitely recommend Los Feliz Small Animal Hospital to other pet owners.

I wish I had taken my dog awhile back to this vet… I had originally taken her to Gateway in Los Feliz but once they became a member of VCA and the vet we liked left, the quality of care went down and my dog had bad experiences that now make her very reactive with the vet. They never once offered a “Chill Protocol” for my dog to help lessen anxiety.

Since going to Los Feliz Small Animal Hospital, my dog has been able to get a full work up and the meds she needs as a senior dog, and yes… she even seems happier now and with more energy. They know how to handle her gently with being aware of her past and they treat her with gentle compassion. They are great!
Thank you for the 5-star review!
Ryan is very through. I appreciated all his advise for cooper

Our beloved Son Sir Levi Justice Martin is always provided with the utmost respect and genuine care. He experience even emergency once and they handled Him with such great care! Now if they do that unbeknownst to them for me then who and what greatness they might offer you and your beloved pets! Awh thank you dearests(:<3(!)

Thank you so much for taking the time to share such thoughtful feedback. We are glad to hear that you’ve had a positive experience with our front desk team, technicians, and doctors since coming to our hospital. 

We would also like to thank you for your honesty regarding appointment availability. You’ve touched on a challenge that many in the veterinary field are currently navigating, and your suggestion about urgent care slots is insightful. We do our best to leave room for urgent cases, but on many days, those slots are filled within minutes of opening. 

We are constantly reviewing our scheduling flow to see how we can better accommodate our patients that are in need of urgent care. Your feedback about being willing to pay an urgent care fee is a helpful data point as we look at ways to potentially expand our emergency capacity.

I was slightly frustrated that this vet office doesn't ship prescriptions to Chewy themselves. But I was extremely frustrated today when the office staff rudely talked over me on the phone while I was trying to get their help. We won't be back.

Please do not use AI. It’s dehumanizing to try to contact the vets office and get shuffled to some AI “Assistant”, That then confirms the wrong time for the appointment and can’t solve the problem of rescheduling with literally any nuance.

What a great service by the friendly and professional staff at The Los Feliz Animal Hospital.  I highly recommend them.  If you want your pet kids to be treated with love and kindness, please stop by The Los Feliz Animal Hospital!!!!
Love the team here - always friendly and they really care about both the patients and their owners.
No matter how busy they get, the staff is always patient and gentle with each pet. No rushing or hastily behavior. It really puts me at ease knowing that my dog and my concerns are listened to.
As the human responsible for two giant breeds, it is a joy to come to such a welcoming environment. Everyone is friendly and attentive to the health issues of each of our crew.

Overall we have had really solid experiences here.  Our dog hates the vet, but the front desk and vet techs are all really sweet and great with calming our dog down.  We miss the old owner, Dr. Costin (who our pup adored), but some of the new doctors there (especially Dr. Ehlinger and Dr. Freedberg) are great.  Overall, we are really happy with Los Feliz Small Animal Hospital.
Los Feliz Small Animal Hospital is wonderful. We always feel taken care of, and it’s clear that everyone who works there truly cares about animals and their people.

I have returned here three times. Once I was not even charged for my dog's small issue. Today, Dr. Connor shared ways to find less expensive medication for my dog's condition - very compassionate and involved. Overall, vet care is expensive these days. But this staff is kind and patient. I also have Trupanion insurance, which helps. And I need to be mindful because everyone is struggling with one thing or another these days.
The vet and staff were professional and friendly.
Best Vet in Los Angeles. They take great care of my babies & I’ve been using them for my pet’s health for 16 years
I was few days ago with my dog! No issues! Wellness exam was done 👍🏼 …

The LFSAH is a great place to bring your pet. Staff is nice and they care about your fur baby. They always have appointment availability which is great when you have an urgent matter and your pet is not well.
The vets was super sweet. They took time to listen to my concerns and made suggestions accordingly. Thank you LFSAH! You have a great big ❤️

Dr. Ehlinger saw Wolfie and was quick to diagnose a problem that another internal medicine vet practice did not find.  Woflie was treated over the next two days and had a great improvement.  The doctor was so excellent at explaining the current situation, next steps and what I could expect, as well as where I can go to get info on proper feeding.  He gave us peace of mind and is a very kind and thorough practitioner.

Dr. Freedberg had the bedside manner of Nurse Rachett. She was aggressive when she examined my cat and lacked any showing of kindness or humanity.  For his initial wellness visit with vaccinations she proceed to rattle off $700 worth of uneccesary services that my otherwise healthy cat "needed." I felt condescended to, grifted, and humiliated.  I will never use her services again. Dr Talwar is amazing and the only reason I will return.
A very caring place
Very experienced and caring. I have recently changed my dog’s primary doctor to this hospital and Dr. Freedberg is amazing.

Always a pleasure to "see" Dr. Costin and staff!  My dog, Jake, got his necessary vaccinations and off we went to training class.

I liked the new system of dropping Jake off and picking him up, I was able to go get gas and lunch while he was getting his exam.
Thank you for the 5-star review!
Our first visit to the veterinary clinic was very nice. The doctor and staff were great, and they have a wonderful vibe in the waiting room. Our senior family cat was taken care of incredibly well.
I brought my 10 week old Maltipoo puppy in for his first visit and the staff was as prompt and courteous as ever. Dr Ehlinger provides great care. We feel lucky to have found him!
Dr Ryan Ehlinger is the best! We have a very anxious dog, and he is super understanding and patient with us every time. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
Thank you for your 5-star review.
Our golden years girl did fabulous with her teeth cleaning. She recovered very nicely from the anesthesia. The staff was very thorough with discharge instructions. We knew she was in great hands.
Everyone here took wonderful care of my cat, Agnes, from receptionist to technician to vet. A caring, patient, and kind practice--couldn't ask for better!

LFSAH saved my dogs life! This is going to be along review, but I am truly so grateful for the entire team at this office and most importantly to Dr. Ehlinger.

My pitbull Luna was adopted 5 weeks ago in the worst shape imaginable, completely deaf from scar tissue covering her ear canals, a cancerous tumor in her mammary gland, and covered in horrendous skin legions and excessively bleeding from her outer ears for months that went untreated at the shelter she was waiting at. She was a backyard breeder mom who was never spayed and had years of medical neglect to recover from. I truly can't imagine how stressful this whole ordeal would have been had I not made the decision to take her to LFSAH.

We have now been here over 15 times in the past month, between tech appointments to change her bandages daily after surgery, to putting a drain in her mammary gland incision, to allergy shots and ear cleaning. That is in addition to the actual surgery that saved her life getting a partial mastectomy and tumor removal that Dr. Ehlinger performed.

I was truly stunned by the level of empathy and warmth everyone here has shown Luna, which is something I was deeply worried about finding as a pitbull owner. I have seen first hand the level of coldness other clinics can treat bully breeds. From our first appointment Luna was already showing significant improvement with allergy treatment and an extremely thorough examination. We just left a tech appointment to get the last of her staples removed today from her mammary incision and the vet techs had her in the back room playing with her and giving her treats, it was so heartwarming to see. Everyone stops to say hi to her when I bring her in. They all take such good care of her no matter who is working that day, I truly feel comfortable leaving her with anyone at this hospital.

I never thought my dog (especially having to endure as much medical trauma as Luna has) would be happy to come to the vet but she truly enjoys every time she comes in! And the amount of improvement she has made is remarkable. She is no longer deaf!! Dr. Ehlinger worked so hard to flush out her ears during her mastectomy and to put her on a medication protocol that she is now hearing for the first time and recognizing her name. Prior to coming here I was told definitively from other vets that she would require a double ear ablation and become permanently deaf after the fact. Now she has a quality of life that is 100000x what she did prior to coming here, and she is in remission from cancer!

I am so looking forward to how much more she will improve with time and just needed to give this place the credit they deserve, because they are responsible for so so much of her recovery. Everyone at the front desk is wonderful too, and compared to the veterinary prices I have paid in the past for my dog and cats in New York, their pricing is very fair for the work they do.

Thank you LFSAH!!
They continue to offer all services in a hygenically safe and remote environment. All personnel is wonderful
Thank you for the 4-star review! If there's anything our team can do to make your experience with us 5-star, please let us know.

This is our 2nd time taking our chihuahua in for a check up on paw licking and butt scooting and last one was she was limping.  Love the way it has been explained to us what is going on and what we can do initially and if it doesn't work then the next step.
Thank you for the 5-star review!

Always great at LFSAH! We love it and so does our dog! Alania was fantastic with our dog AND entertaining our toddler at the same time. Dr. Aura is so caring and calm while working with our pup. We never have any concerns dropping off our little.

Love Los Feliz vet so much! Dr Ryan Elingher is incredible with my cat. He is compassionate and kind. He understands my cat is a senior and doesn’t force unnecessary extra stuff on him. I love how his main concern is to keep him happy! One of the best!
Thank you!

The staff was all incredible. Friendly, thorough, detail-oriented and just so kind. We felt so comfortable and the vet took her time explaining to us each detail since we have a puppy. We love LFSAH and we wouldn’t go anywhere else.

Can't recommend this vet enough. My wife and I took took our injured dog to another local vet office that turned out to be a nightmare both in lack of professionalism and possible malpractice (the manager is not a trained vet and gave us an unverified diagnosis). This place is the opposite. We took our dog here for a second opinion and were met with vets and staff that are both professional and have great bedside manner.

Our dog ended up having a torn ACL and needed surgery. The care and order of operations he's been given have been completely professional and timely and assured us during stressful times. Our main vet is Dr Talwar and she's both empathetic and professional.

Like our past vet we've been to, all good vet offices are often very busy and not the most expensive but not the cheapest. Just bear that in mind when booking an appointment.

I hadn't been to Los Feliz Small Animal Hospital in quite a while. My experience had been that they were "expensive." On this trip, my 9-year old kitty was doing a lot of sneezing and I was concerned there would be a lot of testing required. But I felt my cat was looked at, evaluated, medicine recommended and was also given something to subdue my other cat enough to bring him in at some point.The vet was kind and helpful. I would definitely go back.
Dr Friedman was very carrying. She sent her to a speciality clinic but she’s home now. They determined she didn’t need another surgery.A big dog takes spaying differently to small dogs.
Amazing as always!!
Thank you for the 5-star review!
Great animal hospital, and all the staff typically provide 5-star customer service, and are very loving and kind towards animals.
They did surgery on both of my cats. Both were very successful and now I have two happy cats! Very communicative and personable. The staff in the office is also very nice.

Rosie and the team at Los Feliz Small Animal Hospital are truly amazing. My cat was dealing with significant health issues, so naturally I was very concerned. From the moment I arrived, they were warm and welcoming, clearly explained every procedure and kept me informed every step of the way. They truly underpromised and overdelivered.

I was especially relieved by how caring they were with my little guy and how thorough they were in making sure I understood his care. This has been the best experience I’ve had with veterinary care, and I’ll absolutely be bringing my cats here from now on.
Made me feel like I chose the right place for my kitty.
TOP NOTCH STAFF AND ADMIN STAFF..THANK YOU..41 YEARS AND COUNTING WE HAVE BEEN USING LOS FELIZ SMALL ANIMAL.HOSPITAL...

I love how knowledgeable and patient the entire staff is at LFSAH. Dr. Freedberg and Dr. Ellinger are both fanstatic! The care is personalized and doesn’t feel rushed. My dog actually loves going to the vet. Even my cat, who is no picnic, gets amazing care. Her file has “caution: will bite” in big red stickers all over it…but everyone is very sweet to her here. I’ve also learned some great tips from Dr. Ellinger to give her meds. I totally trust my pets’ well-being with LFSAH.
Thank you for the 5-star review!

My little Peanut had allergies when we moved to LA. I didn’t know what was happening, she had bumps all over her body and I thought it was ticks or fleas. Dr. Talwar is very friendly and helpful. She also had a pet in the past who’s name was Peanut and her telling me this made me feel happy to hear and gave me some comfort. She was able to help my little yorkie figure out what was wrong and was patient with her, as peanut has severe anxiety. This animal hospital is close to where I live. The techs were very helpful as well and gathered a lot of information about Peanut.

1 year update: Reason I never went back is they never ever ever answer the phone, you cant even talk to someone or schedule appointment... not worth it got me as my dog has been ill many times and had to take her elsewhere. Plus its extremely expensive too
Thank you for the 5-star review!

This is a smallish practice, requiring appointments. After years at another much larger clinic I felt my pets weren't being given close attention, which I enjoy at Los Feliz Small Animal Hospital. Recently, I could tell my dog's chronic kidney disease was advancing, so we were able to get in sooner than later. I was correct that Princess Leia was in serious decline. Dr. Khouban was compassionate and careful as she counseled me on an end of life plan for Princess Leia, also following up on our discussion and checking in on the Princess. I think we were lucky she was in the clinic when we came to the clinic this week, but there's no doubt that any other doctor at this clinic would do the same. Staff members are stellar employees and I thank them all for there gentle care and attention.
Very thorough exam and very aware and sensitive to Franny’s fear and pain.
We’re so grateful for your feedback and for choosing us as your pet’s healthcare provider, Elenia!

My cat had a dental cleaning after 3 years with a lot of buildup. Added to this, he has seizures so needs medication. Dr. Ehlinger connected with the neurologist and took great care for an excellent outcome. Thank you to all the staff at lfsah!
It was great!  They have been my vet for many years 😀

My cat was sick and they did everything they could for him. Dr. Ehlinger is especially great, especially his bedside manner in such a hard time. I also bring my dog Pie Dough here and they've always treated her so well. Quite happy here.

I bring both of my cats here and we love Dr. Freedberg! One of my cats was diagnosed with chronic kidney disease and she has been so helpful with the guidance and management of that. My cat was vomiting a lot so she also helped us find inflammatory bowel disease and ureter stones that we are able to manage before they progressed. So grateful for her expertise and all the staff is so kind.
Professional staff,good service.

Recently went as my cat was due for her annual and we moved last year too far from her old vet on the Westside, so we needed a new vet.

They recommended she get her teeth cleaned and even though they had no more openings in Feb during their teeth cleaning discount period, they kindly extended their discount for me as a new customer even though our cleaning date was in early March.

They called the day following the procedure to check on my pet which I really appreciated!

Would recommend!
Dr Ehlinger and team are super attentive and knowledgeable

We've brought all our dogs to LFSAH since 1996. The doctors and staff are kind to animals and humans alike. It's not the same people here now as when we started, but over 20+ years you would expect there to be some change.
The prices are not low--but everything is expensive these days.
Staff and doctors are respectful, patient, and want the best for the animals.

I brought Potato here from the week I adopted her (Sept 2003) through her final illness (February 2016). They took care of her for her entire life. In the last five weeks of her life, they took care of her and of me. Then I adopted Tickety and Dominga. Exceptional care for them as well, including end of life care. Now I bring Burrita there. Exceptional vets, compassionate staff. I couldn't ask for more.
